text:
sophie_cs: Hey team — customer jensen reports their account was suspended this morning after a dunning run. They say a PO was submitted and payment attempt succeeded, but our system flagged VAT mismatch and kicked off collections. Can someone pause collection while we investigate? :pray:

customer_jensen: Hi, yes — our AP uploaded PO #PO-44321 and the card on file did a 3D auth. We got an email that service was suspended and an overdue notice for invoice 2026-INV-00987 (EUR). We absolutely need this unblocked — production traffic impacted. I can share the PO PDF.

mike_billing: Thanks for flagging. I’m pulling the invoice now. Quick note: invoice 2026-INV-00987 shows VAT=0.00 in our system, but PO indicates VAT at 21%. Looks like a tax code mismatch on ingestion.

aria_support_bot: Automated note: account suspension created by dunning-bot at 1783456000 for invoice 2026-INV-00987. Suspension reason: overdue >30 days.

rahul_finops: @mike_billing can you paste the raw invoice metadata? I want to see the tax_country/tax_id fields. Also did the payment gateway return a decline or was the payment accepted?

mike_billing: Paste from billing backend (sanitized):
```
invoice_id: 2026-INV-00987
amount_due: 12500.00
currency: EUR
vat_amount: 0.00
tax_country: ""
po_number: PO-44321 (attached)
payment_attempts: 1
last_payment_status: authorized
```
Gateway logs: `auth` returned success, capture failed due to `post-auth-capture-fail` (gateway code 4023). However customer says card was charged. Need gateway reconciliation.

customer_jensen: Bank shows a pending capture from Redwood for 12500 EUR. AP can reissue a capture if needed. They sent PO with VAT lines attached to this thread.

sophie_cs: Repro steps from our end to surface the bug: 1) Customer uploads PO via support UI, 2) Finance ingestion job `po-sync` runs and writes po_number to invoice, 3) tax calculation uses `tax-country` header which was blank for this customer due to a profile import edge-case, 4) VAT line omitted -> invoice shows 0 VAT, dunning rules fired because outstanding amount didn't match expected payment schedule.

rahul_finops: Proposed remediation steps:
- Temporarily lift suspension for account jensen to restore service (manual override in admin panel).
- Create a credit memo for invoice 2026-INV-00987 adjusting VAT to 21% and recalc balance.
- Coordinate with gateway to capture the authorized funds or void/recharge as AP prefers.
- Patch `po-sync` to not clear tax_country when migrating legacy profiles.

mike_billing: I can un-suspend once finance approves. Will need a ticket id for auditing. Creating internal ticket FIN-2026-1887 and will document actions.

sophie_cs: Timelines: customer needs restore within 2 hours. @rahul_finops can you approve manual override?

rahul_finops: Approve for temporary override. I'll also sign off on credit memo adjustments. Please include these notes in FIN-2026-1887. After we confirm capture, we revert the override.

mike_billing: Done — account unsuspended at 1783458100 (manual override). Notifying customer. I added: "override_by: mike_billing, reason: VAT mismatch pending tax correction, ticket: FIN-2026-1887"

customer_jensen: Thank you! Service restored. Please confirm once capture goes through so we can reconcile with AP.

mike_billing: Next steps assigned: rahul to prepare credit memo; I will open a gateway reconciliation with payments@gateway.com referencing gateway ref GREF-7782; sophie to follow up with customer for any extra docs.

rahul_finops: Credit memo drafted and queued. Will post adjustment to invoice and tag as `tax-correction`. Once posted we'll update invoice status to `pending-capture` and ping payments.

aria_support_bot: Reminder scheduled: follow up in 24h if invoice still unsettled.

sophie_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll keep customer looped in. Copy of PO attached for records. cc @legal if needed for VAT evidence. :thumbsup:

mike_billing: Audit log entries and FIN ticket updated at 1783459000. Closing internal hold once capture confirmed.

rahul_finops: Leaving a note for devs: do not clear tax_country during profile imports — patch PR #3124 created and assigned to eng-billing for backport.

customer_jensen: Appreciate the quick response. Will confirm with AP when capture hits bank.

sophie_cs: Closing thread for now — will reopen if any regressions.
